items.title: Crisp - Orbiting Circle
items.goal: Solid endpoint-colored fireflies circle through the X/Z plane on wobbly deterministic orbits, leaving crisp finite echoes separated by black.

intent.concept: Solid endpoint-colored fireflies circle through the X/Z plane on wobbly deterministic orbits, leaving crisp finite echoes separated by black.
intent.design_intent: Build a deliberately non-blended visual language from solid circular bodies, exact palette endpoints, sharp antialiased edges, and strong black negative space.
intent.why_exists: This prototype tests whether large readable orbital motion can remain chromatically discrete: no RGB interpolation, no feedback blur, and no incidental white or specialty channels.
intent.visual_goal_titanic: At playa distance the Hull should read as several large moving colored discs cut from black, while the outline, stacks, pearls, and paired signs make the complete vessel legible.
intent.unique_topology: Five finite circular bodies use incommensurate cosine and sine wobble on normalized X/Z; each head may cast two smaller geometric echoes with explicit black gaps.
intent.distance_silhouette: Raw-LED strands emphasize narrow body rims and intersections so orbital geometry sharpens the recognizable ship outline instead of washing it into a field.
intent.close_detail: Antialiasing changes only the intensity of the winning endpoint color; overlaps use deterministic winner selection, and Jewelry contributes sparse exact-color pearls.
intent.motion_grammar: Every body advances smoothly along a deterministic orbit with irrationally related wobble frequencies; spacing fans their phases and trail adds finite earlier-phase echoes.
intent.xyz_use: Hull and Silhouette use normalized X/Z directly; Organs use local distance anchors, while Identity folds index modulo 74 into a complete paired 10x8 local sign surface.
intent.te_sign_treatment: Both physical TE signs render the same balanced 74-pixel local orbit plaque using index modulo 74; addresses 40 through 73 continue the surface rather than repeating 0 through 33.
intent.jewelry_white: Jewelry uses sparse exact Color 1 or Color 2 pearls only; native white is deliberately absent and W=A=U remain zero.
intent.palette_white_material: Every lit RGB pixel is a scalar multiple of exactly Color 1 or exactly Color 2. Endpoints are never mixed with each other; black is the default material and W=A=U are always zero.
intent.safety_floor: The saved floor is zero for strong black negative space. Raising sliderSafetyFloor adds only a low exact-endpoint visibility bed, never gray or an interpolated hue.
intent.anti_duplication_notes: Keep the solid endpoint-only bodies, hard black gaps, and finite echoes distinct from 36_orbital_pulse, 118_grand_orbit_rings, and party_dancers/01; do not soften this into gradients, waves, or a continuous ring field.

fixture_roles.Hull Canvas: Large filled X/Z circular bodies and finite separated echoes carry the primary composition.
fixture_roles.Silhouette: Narrow exact-color rims and deterministic intersection accents sharpen boundaries and the ship outline.
fixture_roles.Jewelry: Sparse moving exact-color pearls add nearby detail without white or generalized sparkle.
fixture_roles.Organs: Low steady endpoint anchors keep stacks and structural fixtures present beneath passing bodies.
fixture_roles.Identity: Both TE signs receive the same complete balanced 74-pixel local 2D orbit composition.

controls.behavior: Sets the smooth orbital cadence of every body and finite echo.
Changes the radius of all solid antialiased circular bodies.
Selects one through five active circular bodies.
Changes inter-body phase separation and the radial fan of the orbits.
Changes the number, separation, and size of finite geometric echoes.
Raises a low endpoint-colored visibility bed from the saved black default.

intent.evidence_notes: Source, paired byte-identical playlists, offline model gates, focused exact-channel tests, parameter-truth probes, and the Global Speed 0.30 gallery provide the review evidence.

uniqueness_review.duplicated_grammar: Orbital motion exists elsewhere, but no nearby pattern commits to filled endpoint-only fireflies with winner-take-all overlaps and discrete finite echoes.
uniqueness_review.underexplored_opportunity: Hard-edged color bodies and designed black gaps offer a readable non-blended material language that is otherwise rare in the catalog.

nearest_neighbors.reason: Shares orbiting motion, but centers a pulsing orbit rather than multiple discrete filled bodies and finite echoes.
Shares monumental orbital geometry, but uses ring architecture rather than solid endpoint-only fireflies.
Shares paired color authority, but uses broad audio-driven bands instead of autonomous circular bodies.

uniqueness_review.refinement_directive: Preserve the exact endpoint contract, large filled circles, hard negative space, and paired sign plaque while tuning only scale, staging, and motion readability.
